conventions.normal: tangent-space, OpenGL convention (+Y up = Poly Haven nor_gl), linear data (NoColorSpace)
conventions.arm: linear data: R = ambient occlusion, G = roughness, B = metalness
conventions.height: linear data, single channel 8-bit, 1024x1024, white = up. displacementMeters = ( sample - heightMean ) * heightScaleMeters, where heightScaleMeters (black-to-white range) was calibrated by least-squares matching the height-field slopes to the normal map (heightFit.corrU/corrV = correlation of that fit; both positive confirms the OpenGL normal convention)
conventions.tiling: all maps wrap seamlessly (RepeatWrapping); uv = worldPositionMeters / tileSizeMeters
conventions.avgColorLinear: linear-sRGB mean of the albedo (what the smallest mip converges to); use for distant terrain colour / far LOD
conventions.recommended: optional per-set hints: albedoTint = linear RGB multiplier applied to the albedo sample (may exceed 1); aoIntensity = strength to apply the AO channel with (ao = mix(1, aoSample, aoIntensity)); roughnessBias = value to add to the roughness sample; detailRepeatMeters = repeat size for an additional detail-normal sample; note/aoNote = why

sets.intent: natural green alpine meadow ground (short grass, moss, dry stalks, twigs)
sets.author: Rob Tuytel

recommended.note: Raw scan is a yellowish green-tan (lots of dry material). Multiply albedo by albedoTint for a fresh alpine-meadow green; use 1,1,1 towards late-summer/dry areas. Meant as the ground under instanced grass blades.
recommended.aoNote: AO map is very dark (mean 0.477); use aoMapIntensity ~0.5 (ao = mix(1, aoSample, 0.5)) so ambient light matches the other layers (their mean AO is 0.75-0.97).

sets.intent: flat hot-dip galvanized steel with zinc spangle and a few rust runs (guard rails, sign posts)
sets.author: Jenelle van Heerden, Dimitrios Savva
sets.derived: Derived from the Poly Haven "corrugated_iron" scan (galvanized corrugated sheet) to get a FLAT galvanized sheet: the vertically low-passed corrugation banding was divided out of albedo, AO and roughness; metalness is a constant 1 (the scan's rust runs are dropped); normal + height are a very subtle emboss of the zinc spangle derived from the flattened albedo (mean slope 0.03), because the scanned normal/displacement only contain the corrugation. Re-encoded JPEG q95 4:4:4.
